title: Decline of the IVC: more evidence and sites

boxes.title: Evidence for each theory
head: Theory
Evidence
rows: Indus changed course; ==**Chanhudaro** flooded several times==
Deforestation, **soil salinity**, overgrazing; copper, timber exhausted

boxes.title: Deoria Tal & consensus
items: Dated by ==**AMS radiocarbon** on **Trapa** seed cases==
4.2 ka aridity also linked with fall of **Akkad**
Consensus causes: failure of **urban management**, loss of cohesion

boxes.title: Late Harappan: added detail
items: ==**Five zones**==: West Punjab, East Punjab, Jhukar, Rangpur, Doab
Long-distance trade weakens; local **subsistence farming** grows

cards.title: Discontinuity
lines: **Horse, chariot, iron** absent in Mature Harappan

boxes.title: Other continuity & AP
items: **Bead-making** in Gujarat; fire altars; burial practices
Caution: may reflect **similar functions**, not survival
AP: Chalcolithic remains at ==**Patapadu** (Kurnool)== and Krishna district
